floater.name: pose_polish
floater.title: POSE POLISH

check_box.label: Enable Pose Polish (master)
check_box.name: polish_master_check
check_box.tool_tip: Master gate for the post-blend Pose Polish stage (inertialization, contact stabilization, secondary motion). Off = no-op, displayed pose unchanged.

floater.text: All sub-toggles below require the master switch above to be ON to take effect.

check_box.label: Transition inertialization (stops AO/gesture snapping)
check_box.name: polish_inertia_check
check_box.tool_tip: Velocity-preserving transition inertialization (kills AO/gesture snap). Off = no-op. Requires the master switch above.

check_box.label: Foot contact stabilizer (IK)
check_box.name: polish_contact_check
check_box.tool_tip: Leg IK holds planted feet in world space (anti-footskate). Grounded biped locomotion only; off while sitting/flying. Off = no-op. Requires the master switch above.

slider.label: Contact strength
slider.name: polish_contact_weight_slider
slider.tool_tip: Maximum IK correction blend (0-1) applied to hip/knee/ankle rotations while a foot is planted. The correction ramps in/out toward this cap.

check_box.label: Phase-matched walk/run starts
check_box.name: polish_phasematch_check
check_box.tool_tip: Phase-aware locomotion: start a new walk/run clip near a compatible foot-plant phase. Off = stock cadence behavior. Requires the master switch above.

check_box.label: Loop-seam repair
check_box.name: polish_loopseam_check
check_box.tool_tip: Repairs the one-frame hitch at a looping animation's seam by pulsing the inertializer across the wrap. Off = no-op. Requires the master switch above and Transition inertialization.

check_box.label: Secondary motion (breath + idle sway)
check_box.name: polish_secondary_check
check_box.tool_tip: Procedural secondary motion (subtle breath + idle weight-shift sway). Off = no-op. Requires the master switch above.

slider.label: Sway amount
slider.name: polish_secondary_sway_slider
slider.tool_tip: Idle weight-shift sway amplitude scale (0 disables sway).

check_box.label: Layer diagnostic overlay
check_box.name: polish_diagnostic_check
check_box.tool_tip: Per-joint layer "current owner" diagnostic overlay for Director tools. Off = no overlay.
